summary_en: 215,854 shares (2.16% of shares outstanding) to be cancelled on 2026-09-30. Post-cancellation, issued shares outstanding will total 9,754,972. Cancellation is conditional on shareholder approval of a stock consolidation (effective 2026-10-01) at the extraordinary general meeting scheduled for 2026-08-28.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-06, Jimoty,Inc.'s board of directors resolved under Companies Act Article 178 to cancel 215,854 treasury shares held by the company. The shares represent 2.16% of issued shares outstanding (pre-cancellation). Cancellation is scheduled for 2026-09-30. Post-cancellation, issued shares outstanding will total 9,754,972. The cancellation is conditional upon shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for 2026-08-28 of a stock consolidation with an effective date of 2026-10-01, which is disclosed in a separate press release. The 215,854 shares to be cancelled represent all treasury shares held by the company as of 2026-08-06.
